name: Nullweave Cubicle Blouse — Standard Drape
description: A collarless pull-on blouse in pale sand or muted teal, made from Nullweave's budget synth-silk that photographs well under fluorescent light. The back panel has a wide pleat to accommodate basic spinal rig frames up to Class 2. Mass-produced in runs of ten thousand; the wearer's floor likely has six identical blouses in rotation.
functionality: Spinal rig back-pleat accommodation, wrinkle-resistant fabric, machine washable.
what_it_says: You bought this because it was on the approved vendor list and it was the cheapest option that still looked presentable.
story_hooks: Nullweave batches from lot 7-C have a dye flaw that makes them glow faintly under UV — wearers have been flagged by building security sensors.
A clerk wore this blouse every day for three years; the pleat is permanently stretched to the exact shape of a rig she no longer has.

physical_description.visual_profile: Loose, understated drape with a boxy silhouette. Collarless neckline sits flat and minimal. The wide back pleat creates subtle vertical flow from shoulders to hem, designed to avoid binding over augmentation hardware. Overall effect is corporate-anonymous—intentionally forgettable.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed, straight-cut through torso and sleeves. Deliberately non-tailored to accommodate Class 2 spinal rigs and subcutaneous implants without tension. Hem hits mid-hip. Sleeve length hits wrist bone. Fit prioritizes functionality over body definition.
physical_description.primary_material: Budget synth-silk—lightweight synthetic blend optimized for fluorescent office environments. Affordable, crease-resistant, slightly plasticky sheen.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, uniform weave with a subtle sheen. Intentionally bland tactile profile. No visible texture variation; designed to appear identical across multiple units.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pale sand (off-white/cream) or muted teal (desaturated cyan-gray). Both are institutional neutrals chosen to minimize visual interest under harsh overhead lighting. No pattern; solid color throughout.
physical_description.closures: Pull-on design—no zippers, snaps, or buttons. Relaxed neckline opens wide enough for easy dressing over augmentation.
distinctive_features: Wide back pleat running full length—accommodation feature for spinal rigs
Seams designed for rapid manufacturing—visible topstitching in matching thread
Zero branding visible; manufacturer tag sewn into side seam
Slight pilling characteristic of budget synth-silk after 20+ wears
Generic construction—intentionally indistinguishable from identical units in same wardrobe rotation
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional working-class. Affordable, mass-produced, engineered for utility in corporate office environments. Signals wage-labor compliance.
physical_description.cultural_context: Cubicle worker, data processor, administrative staff, corpo mid-level. Wearer is likely part of a uniform rotation system—identical blouses in same closet. Signals economic tier below custom tailoring, above salvage-wear. No personal style investment.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in after first wash. Slight pilling on back and sleeves after 30+ wears. Possible discoloration around neckline from perspiration/skincare products. Seams remain intact; synth-silk resists tearing. Usually laundered weekly but never pressed—wrinkles are expected and unremarkable.
